targetText: The first contradiction is the contradiction between labour and capital. Imperialism is the omnipotence of the monopolist trusts and syndicates, of the banks and the financial oligarchy, in the industrial countries. In the fight against this omnipotence, the customary methods of the working class: trade unions and cooperatives, parliamentary parties and the parliamentary struggle: have proved to be totally inadequate. Either place yourself at the mercy of capital, eke out a wretched existence as of old and sink lower and lower, or adopt a new weapon: this is the alternative imperialism puts before the vast masses of the proletariat. Imperialism brings the working class to revolution.
summary: Imperialist monopoly capital intensifies class exploitation beyond the capacity of legal trade unionism.
explanation: Under monopoly capitalism, the financial oligarchy and giant corporate syndicates concentrate economic power to an extreme degree. Peaceful, reformist parliamentary methods and legal trade union negotiations become completely inadequate to defend working-class survival, leaving socialist revolution as the only viable path forward.

targetText:
Because Russia was the focus of all these contradictions of imperialism.
 
Because Russia, more than any other country, was pregnant with revolution, and she alone, therefore, was in a position to solve those contradictions in a revolutionary way.
summary: Tsarist Russia concentrated all contradictions of imperialism, making it the flashpoint of world revolution.
explanation: Russia stood at the junction of brutal capitalist exploitation, colonial oppression in the borderlands, and militarist despotism, while harboring the most militant, revolutionary proletariat. Solving these combined contradictions required breaking the entire chain of international capital.
context: In 1917, Tsarist Russia was embroiled in catastrophic military defeat, economic collapse, and massive peasant uprisings against landlords, creating a unique historical convergence that propelled the Bolsheviks to power.
